continuationGovernor.stopReason: The real issuedonce.shop customer journey remains live-proven through encrypted shipping persistence. A prepayment control-plane audit found Owner OS readiness had drifted from production runtime in three ways: it required ISSUED_ONCE_CATALOG_JSON even though production uses the audited boot catalog fallback, it still defaulted OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL to gpt-image-2 while the production design gateway now defaults to gpt-image-1.5 for transparent PNG artwork, and it could report explicit gpt-image-2 as ready even though production rejects it while alpha transparency is required. TDD RED was observed with 112 unrelated test files passing and exactly the 3 new readiness assertions failing. Commit e6b5637568f9937a9e2b763a0146bcc1c0475f04 aligns readiness with runtime. CI run 32401649135 and Browser QA run 32401649132 are both successful, including the real production customer journey. Safepay sandbox credentials and endpoint registration remain the first genuine external owner gate and cannot be written through available connected tooling.
